title: Remove stale record-count metadata from Hunch documentation
context: Hunch documentation across multiple configuration files contained auto-generated or manually-maintained inventory counts ('262 decisions, 2 bugs, 28 constraints...') that drifted quickly and required ongoing maintenance to stay accurate.
decision: Strip the specific record-count inventory sentence from all Hunch introductions, keeping only the conceptual description: 'a curated graph of *why* the code is the way it is (decisions, bug history, invariants)'.
consequences: Documentation no longer contains stale metrics that contradict reality
Eliminated ongoing maintenance burden of syncing record counts across 5 files
Readers understand Hunch's conceptual purpose without false precision
Less cognitive load in onboarding docs (fewer numbers to parse)
alternatives_rejected: Automate count regeneration in CI/CD (still requires tooling, still stales between runs)
Manually update on release (drifts immediately, creates false sense of accuracy)
Move to single source file (still requires updates, still becomes stale)
